She came to destroy me. Now I’ll burn the world to keep her.
 
She gets beneath my skin. Haunts my thoughts.
Strips away my control.
 
And I keep going back for more.
 
Every glance pulls me deeper. Every touch weakens my grip. And when she looks at me with those silver eyes full of secrets and fury, I know I’m already lost.
 
Something dark is closing in around us.
 
Power is shifting. Truths are unraveling. And the woman I can’t stay away from may be the key to it all.
 
I should walk away before she ruins me. Before this obsession consumes us. But when she’s in my arms, nothing else matters.
 
Not the lies.
Not the danger.
Not even what’s coming.
 
Because once I claim something as mine, I never let it go.
 
And I’m beginning to realize she was always meant to be mine.
 
New York Times and USA Today bestselling author Donna Grant delivers a scorching story of obsession, betrayal, dangerous magic, and irresistible desire in the next installment in the Skye Druids series.
